purpose: Weekly and on-demand migration of bare (unprefixed) labels on issues and PRs to canonical labels using .github/reports/label-remediation/bare-label-mapping.json, with a Markdown report.

jobs.summary: Checkout, setup Node 24, npm ci; load the mapping into step outputs; for each bare label list matching issues/PRs; rewrite each item's label set (unless dry-run); build a report, emit it as a notice and upload REMEDIATION_REPORT.md.

scripts_called.note: JSON mapping read by inline node; no external script

failure_points.issue: Scheduled runs write labels: DRY_RUN comes from github.event.inputs.dry_run, which is empty on schedule, so dryRun is false.
issues.listForRepo is called once per label with per_page 100 and no pagination, so items beyond the first 100 are missed.
issues.update replaces the item's whole label set from a read taken moments earlier (race with concurrent changes).
8 of the 77 mapping entries target labels that are not in labels.yml, so remediation would add non-canonical labels.
Item type is derived from `item.title`, which PRs also have, so every item is logged as 'Issue'.
Configuration data is read from a reports folder rather than from labels.yml or another config file.
always() report steps JSON.parse empty outputs and throw if the query step failed, hiding the original error.

overlaps_with: labeling-unified.yml / labeling.agent.js standardisation step (per item; removes rather than migrates)
